name: rounD
summary: 使用无人机在德国环岛采集的自然道路参与者轨迹数据集，面向无信号、高交互交通场景中的车辆、行人和骑行者行为建模。
summaryEn: A naturalistic road-user trajectory dataset recorded by drones at German roundabouts, targeting behavior modeling in unsignalized, highly interactive traffic scenes with vehicles, pedestrians, and cyclists.
scale: Naturalistic road-user trajectories recorded at three German roundabouts
scaleZh: 在德国 3 个环岛采集的自然道路参与者轨迹
organizations: Institute for Automotive Engineering, RWTH Aachen University, and fka GmbH
organizationsZh: RWTH Aachen University 汽车工程研究所与 fka GmbH
license: Free for non-commercial research under leveLXData/rounD terms; redistribution is restricted
licenseZh: 按 leveLXData/rounD 条款可免费用于非商业研究；再分发受限
access: Official leveLXData/rounD request page; access requires agreeing to dataset terms
accessZh: 官方 leveLXData/rounD 申请页面；访问需同意数据集条款
verdict: 环岛场景的高交互道路参与者轨迹
verdictEn: Highly interactive road-user trajectories at roundabouts
wmNote: 环岛合流、让行和绕行行为为多智能体交互世界模型提供了紧凑但困难的评测场景；规模小于 openDD 等后续环岛数据集。
wmNoteEn: Merging, yielding, and circulating behavior at roundabouts create compact but difficult benchmarks for interactive world models, though the scale is smaller than later roundabout datasets such as openDD.
